global_interpretation: This research prototype routes inputs to endpoint-compatible, separately installed local predictors. It does not convert rank-only scores to calibrated efficiencies, and it does not fabricate values when a backend is unavailable or an input contract is unmet. Current benchmark evidence is task-specific: the Fig. 2 panel was label-blind and excluded exact matches to known CRISPRon-BE development sequences, but training overlap remains unresolved for DeepBE, FORECasT-BE and DeepBaseEditor; the current benchmark contains no strict-external performance evaluation.
